newsitem.title: USA: Ill lawmakers approved $18.175 bln gen fund budget.
newsitem.headline: Ill lawmakers approved $18.175 bln gen fund budget.

text.p: Illinois lawmakers approved an approximately $18.175 general fund budget for fiscal 1998 that included a $342 million increase for elementary and secondary schools, a state budget bureau spokeswoman said Tuesday.
The General Assembly approved $35.618 billion of spending for all funds in the fiscal year beginning July 1 in the session concluded Saturday, spokeswoman Ellen Feldhausen said.
The state Bureau of the Budget has not completed analysis of the spending plans approved by lawmakers and those numbers will change slightly, Feldhausen added.

Overall, legislators approved $4.52 billion of spending for elementary and secondary education, Feldhausen said. About $100 million of the increase in that budget has come from projected state revenue growth through the end of fiscal 1998, she said.
Lawmakers also approved a $115 million increase in the higher education budget to $2.07 billion, Feldhausen said.
The state budget bureau has estimated $213 million of revenue growth for Illinois through the end of fiscal 1998, Feldhausen said.
